name: Forced Order
label: Revelation
lede: Five Southern Californians from Twitching Tongues, Disgrace and Soul Search spent four years rebuilding 1990s Cleveland hardcore, crunch and all, then played their last show in the Santa Ana club where they'd once celebrated Vanished Crusade.

eras.title: Cleveland, by way of Southern California
eras.text: Forced Order came together from Southern California bands Twitching Tongues, Disgrace, Soul Search and Harness, aiming squarely at the metallic Cleveland hardcore of Integrity, Ringworm and In Cold Blood. Within a year of their first record, Revelation had signed them.

years.h: Forced Order's first record, Eternal War, comes out on Mass Movement
years.p: Eight songs, from Fight 'Em Off to Downcast, recorded in January 2014 by [[Taylor Young|b819904a-345d-4cc9-95b9-ee0bf9b3c3d2]] at The Pit and mastered by Brad Boatright.
years.xp: Punknews described the band's sound as "heavy and tight" and influenced by '90s Cleveland metallic hardcore like [[Integrity|f626335d-d234-408d-a67c-37a3c2c7e98a]] and In Cold Blood. It also called this release a demo and 7"; Bandcamp lists Eternal War as an eight-song record, so the page treats it as the debut.

years.h: Mid-tour with Angel Du$t, Forced Order sign to Revelation
years.p: Punknews reports the deal came while the band toured the US with [[Angel Du$t|36c8b01c-cd8b-4ecd-b3fd-9f4f73371d2b]]. A 7" was due that winter and a full-length in early 2015.

years.src: Revelation Records: Forced Order · Revelation Records: pressing history · Bandcamp
years.h: Retribution, cut at the studio behind Integrity records
years.p: Bill Korecky records the 7" at the Mars Compound, which also made In Cold Blood records. The last track, Ekloh (Vanished Crusade), names the album to come.
years.xp: It's REV 156. Revelation's first pressing was 335 yellow, 550 burgundy and 797 grey opaque copies.

eras.title: On the road with Turnstile
eras.text: Vanished Crusade put Forced Order on bills with Bane, Turnstile, Burn and Ceremony, and on a first trip across Europe. Decibel called them skull-cracking old-school.

years.h: Decibel streams Vanished Crusade a week early
years.p: Revelation puts out the fourteen-song album as REV 161, produced by [[Taylor Young|b819904a-345d-4cc9-95b9-ee0bf9b3c3d2]] at The Pit. Metal Injection gives it 9/10.

years.h: Forced Order hit the road with Bane and Turnstile
years.p: Twenty-six North American dates, August 6 to 31, with Backtrack, Mizery and Heavy Chains on the whole run.
years.xp: Guests on individual dates included [[Power Trip|7f179acc-d6eb-4ca9-af90-c14e397fb613]] and [[Death Threat|10bc16b4-567d-4bb0-b455-3ad0db178975]]. A fan filmed the whole Greensboro set on August 10.

years.h: The Vanished Crusade LP drops, and Burn come to Santa Ana
years.p: Revelation's vinyl edition comes out the day Forced Order play The Observatory with [[Burn|502429d5-da95-4a78-bfc9-7c8cf93504e6]] and Soul Search, a band several of them came from.
years.xp: That fall they also played San Francisco's Great American Music Hall and Santa Cruz with [[Ceremony|c13da818-d566-4f2a-aaaf-1c68301ddc43]], and Los Angeles with [[Trapped Under Ice|94c44a31-3f7b-4c5d-aa54-2bf47eeac5d5]].

years.p: Thirteen cities between November 18 and 30, among them Amsterdam, Berlin, London and Paris.
The set is at The Orpheum, and California dates with Foundation follow.

eras.title: A second album, then the exit
eras.text: Forced Order's second album came out on Triple B, not Revelation, with the same five members, who stayed together to the end. The last show was at the Santa Ana venue where they'd celebrated Vanished Crusade.

years.h: One Last Prayer comes out on Triple B, not Revelation
years.p: No Echo's reviewer gives the second album 9/10 and hears clearer production than Vanished Crusade. His one complaint: it left him wanting more.
years.xp: The review singles out the title track, Perpetual Dusk, Tears Will Fall and Play Dead, which leads into the instrumental closer Consecration/Winter Resistance. Nic Samayoa sings, Mike Cesario and Kyle Thomas play guitar, Alfredo Gutierrez bass and Dorian Zambrano drums.

years.h: The last show is in Santa Ana, with all five members
years.p: Forced Order play the Constellation Room at The Observatory on September 22, 2018, the same five who made Eternal War.
years.xp: Last.fm's biography is the only source for the 2014 to 2018 span and the date. 197 Media filmed the full set in 4K.
